meta.description: Breathing new life into Irish linen heritage. Birthed with a passion to breathe new life into our Irish heritage, we use locally sourced Irish linen to create timeless womenswear pieces, all made in Ireland with heritage and heart.

mission.headingHtml: Manifesto Kindred of Ireland is a modern heritage house rooted in linen, place and people. We honour Ireland’s textile traditions by carrying them forward through contemporary design, local craft, and clothing made to hold story.

craftsmanshipTop.descriptionHtml: The summer that made way for the gathering. Linen for the warmer days still to come, with many pieces now in their final sizes.

craftsmanshipBottom.descriptionHtml: Rooted in the landscape of this island, craftsmanship here is a story of patience, skill and enduring tradition. We are proud to work with and champion local makers and endangered Irish crafts to help keep this heritage alive.
Kindred of Ireland was founded on a shared vision: to reimagine Irish linen for modern living, rooted in craftsmanship, heritage and story.
Discover our Bridal Collection, a romantic expression of Irish linen for modern brides.

bridal.descriptionHtml: Woven for us in the hills of south-west Donegal, in the colours of the landscape itself. A romantic reimagining of Ireland's most storied cloth, made to order and designed to outlast every season.
